subject.title: [Bug]: Heartbeat / async system events can interrupt and effectively swallow in-progress replies in Telegram topic sessions

question: Should #64810 remain the canonical Telegram heartbeat/session-lane tracker, or should maintainers split and close it in favor of narrower heartbeat isolation and stale-replay issues after live proof?
rationale: The narrow active-reply race is fixed, but remaining reports mix heartbeat isolation policy, Telegram delivery boundaries, restart recovery, and default-target replay in ways automation should not collapse into one more small fix.

options.title: Keep canonical until proved or split
options.body: Keep #64810 open, retire or reconcile the stale linked PR, and require live Telegram proof before closing or splitting the remaining symptoms.

options.title: Split into narrower trackers
options.body: Move default-target stale replay and heartbeat isolation/default-routing policy into separate canonical issues, then close this issue only after those links are explicit.

options.title: Close after live current-main proof
options.body: Close this issue only if a maintainer-run Telegram topic scenario on current main shows no reply loss, stale replay, or wrong-target delivery across the reported wake paths.

recommendation.title: Keep canonical until proved or split
recommendation.body: Keep #64810 open, retire or reconcile the stale linked PR, and require live Telegram proof before closing or splitting the remaining symptoms.

likelyOwner.reason: kesslerio has both a recent stale-replay report in this thread and the adjacent stale-final suppression change, making them the best available owner for the remaining proof/split decision.
